text:
Maya Chen: kicking off deploy for model-routing-v3 feature flag now. Canary plan: 2% -> 5% -> 10% over 15m. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release/CI-328

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @Maya Chen. running preflight checks: infra ok, quota ok, schema validation ok. will post cohort progress here.

Luis Ortega: quick note — staging perf looked fine, baseline p95 ~120ms. i'll monitor errors.

Arjun Patel: commander for ff toggles. planned command: `/ff set model-routing-v3 cohorts=2%,5%,10% schedule=15m` (will execute after green from oncall).

Sara Kim: adding trace watchers and synthetic checks. hooking up the golden prompt set.

deploy-bot: Canary cohort 2% enabled -> healthy. starting 5% ramp. (progress: 2% -> enabled)

Luis Ortega: seeing a small uptick in 5xx from eu-west-1 after 5% ramp — +0.5% absolute. p50 up ~4ms. not huge but trending. logs: `rpc=serve_model duration=157ms error=502 trace_id=abcd1234`

Maya Chen: hold the ramp. pausing at 5% while we triage. @Oncall Ops can you confirm whether to pin back?

Oncall Ops: checked dashboards — 5xx jump and increased tail latency. recommend fast-failover: pin to last stable model (v2.3.1) and drain cohorts.

Arjun Patel: running pin now: `deploy-bot pin model-routing v2.3.1 --reason "canary errors" --urgency high`

deploy-bot: Pin request accepted. initiating fast-failover: shifting cohorts to pinned model. starting draining of model-routing-v3 KV caches and redirecting traffic. ETA ~2m. :arrow_right:

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. model-routing-v3 cohorts disabled; traffic pinned to v2.3.1. change log note: CI-328 - fast-failover executed by Maya Chen. :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. Action items: 1) Arjun — collect repro logs and identify root cause, 2) Luis/Sara — add finer-grained canary alert at 0.3% 5xx and cache-miss metric, 3) I'll update release notes and schedule a staged replay in staging with larger traffic.

Arjun Patel: copying logs to ticket and starting a reproducer run. issue: https://tracker.internal/CI-328

Sara Kim: draft release note updated: https://docs.internal/release-notes/ci-328 (marked rollback & follow-ups).

deploy-bot: change-window closed for this fast-failover. postmortem reminder set for tomorrow 11:00 PT.

Maya Chen: good catch, everyone. we'll retarget v3 after fixes and a longer staging replay. :thumbsup:
